description: Legal airworthiness sign-off ledger pre-populating UK MOD Form 700 / AFTO Form 781 airworthiness release certificates. Enforces strict Human-in-the-Loop engineering review before an aircraft can return to flight.

fields.name: release_package_id
fields.description: Primary Key (PK, Cluster Key): Formal airworthiness release package identifier (e.g., AWR-700-20261102-ZM151).

fields.name: appraisal_report_uri
fields.description: Cloud Storage URI pointing to the signed MIL-STD-3001 Structural Appraisal Report PDF (e.g., gs://antig-dave-f35-staging-europe-west1/unstructured/sar/SAR-20261102-ZM151.pdf).

fields.name: mandated_jtd_task_card
fields.description: Mandatory maintenance procedure required prior to flight clearance: 'JTD Task Card 53-11-00-280' (Fastener Torque-Recheck).

fields.name: disposition_status
fields.description: Valid enum values: 'SERVICEABLE_WITH_TORQUE_RECHECK', 'GROUNDED_DEPOT_TEARDOWN', or 'UNRESTRICTED_SERVICEABLE'. Engineering disposition (0.012 in < 0.015 in allowable limit).

fields.name: hitl_reviewer_role
fields.description: Mandatory human authority role required for sign-off: 'Lead Stress Engineer' / 'Chief Technical Officer (CTO) / Lead Stress Engineer'.

fields.name: hitl_review_status
fields.description: Cluster Key. State machine gate enum: starts strictly as 'PENDING_HITL_REVIEW', transitioned strictly to 'CONFIRMED_BY_ENGINEER' upon human approval in a subsequent turn.

fields.name: compliance_standard
fields.description: Governing military airworthiness certification basis: 'MIL-STD-3001 / DEF STAN 00-970 / MIL-HDBK-516C'.
